findings.T1: fixed: a text page (operation, readiness, Details, Help, policy, Agents) longer than its rows ends each screen but the last with a muted '… N more lines below' in its last row, as the prototype ends a clipped frame. The blocked operation at 48x16 ends its first screen '… 4 more lines below' (after-0004), then 3 after j (after-0005), and the last screen shows 'Retry resumes exact captured intent; changed / inputs need a new request.' with no cue (after-0007); before, the first screen ended at 'Leaving this screen does not cancel an' with nothing below it but the controls (before-0004). Help ends '… 20 more lines below' and Details '… 8 more lines below' at 48x16 (after-0093, after-0096). Page Down and Page Up (and Ctrl+F/B) move an inspection page by the lines a screen shows above its cue, one less than its rows, so paging skips no line (after3-0003, after3-0005; the fix as first built skipped 'attachment', mid-0003). The text is still wrapped at 44 columns: wrapping at 48 would leave the blocked page 14 lines for 12 rows
